crossRefs.note: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail…
The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and animal; and the hail struck…
He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.
translations.bsb: And the next day the LORD did just that. All the livestock of the Egyptians died, but not one animal belonging to the Israelites died.
translations.kjv: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
translations.asv: And Jehovah did that thing on the morrow; and all the cattle of Egypt died; but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
